name: canvas-study
description: Ask Claude about your Canvas courses: deadlines, grades and course materials, answered from your own courses with links to the Canvas page. Unofficial, not made by Instructure.

canvas_base_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_base_url.description: Your school's Canvas address, for example https://canvas.cmu.edu

canvas_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_token.description: In Canvas: Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token. Stored in your system keychain and only used on this computer.
